source.title: Can AI design circuit boards yet?
source.author: iopapa

title.zh: AI PCB设计：从仿真到真实工程
title.en: AI PCB Design: From Simulation to Engineering

excerpt.zh: AI PCB设计已经能处理一批可验证的电路任务，但EEBench显示，器件偏差、成本、供应和实物验证仍是关键门槛。
excerpt.en: AI PCB design can now solve a growing set of verifiable circuit tasks, but EEBench shows that tolerances, cost, supply, and hardware validation remain major barriers.

text.zh: AI PCB设计正在进入可测量阶段
text.en: AI PCB Design Enters a Measurable Phase

text.zh: AI PCB设计已经不再只是演示中的概念。EEBench围绕电源、模拟和数字电路建立了一套公开评测，尝试回答一个比“模型能否在KiCad里操作”更实际的问题：模型产出的电路是否满足明确的工程要求。OpenAI展示GPT-6 Astra在KiCad中工作的演示后，这个问题获得了更多关注，但现有证据仍主要集中在仿真和设计验证，而不是完整产品交付。
text.en: AI PCB design is no longer only a demonstration concept. EEBench has created a public evaluation around analog and digital circuit tasks, asking a more practical question than whether a model can operate KiCad: does the resulting circuit satisfy explicit engineering requirements? OpenAI’s demonstration of GPT-6 Astra working in KiCad has increased attention, but the current evidence is still concentrated on simulation and design verification rather than complete product delivery.

text.zh: EEBench如何检验电路，而不只看图纸
text.en: How EEBench Tests Circuits Beyond Their Schematics

text.zh: EEBench把设计写成声明式代码，让智能体直接处理元件、连接和电气约束。提交结果会被构建成电路图和物料清单，再运行确定性的SPICE仿真与设计检查。评测可以测量电压、增益、阈值、纹波和瞬态响应，并把每项结果与规格上下限比较。这样，模型不能仅凭一张“看起来合理”的原理图获得高评价。
text.en: EEBench represents a design as declarative code, allowing an agent to work directly with components, connections, and electrical constraints. A submission is built into a circuit graph and bill of materials, followed by deterministic SPICE simulations and design checks. The evaluation can measure voltage, gain, thresholds, ripple, and transient response, comparing each result with specification limits. A schematic that merely looks plausible is therefore not enough for a strong result.

text.zh: 一个住宅电表任务说明了这种差异。输入的5伏电源断开后，电路需要让处理器继续工作20毫秒，并在这段时间保持电压高于3.0伏的掉电复位阈值。模型通常会想到增加电容，但真实陶瓷电容在偏压下可能只有标称容量的一部分，还要面对容差、额定电压、封装、成本以及重新充电速度。某次提交使用标称22微法的电容，仿真发现4.7伏偏压下有效容量只有11.4微法，电压在0.85毫秒后就低于要求。电路虽然成功构建，仍然没有完成任务。
text.en: A residential energy-meter task illustrates the difference. When its 5-volt input disappears, the circuit must keep the processor alive for 20 milliseconds while maintaining the rail above the 3.0-volt brownout threshold. Models commonly identify the need for a capacitor, but a real ceramic capacitor may provide only part of its nominal value under bias. Tolerance, voltage rating, package, cost, and recharge behavior also matter. In one submission, a nominal 22-microfarad capacitor delivered only 11.4 microfarads at 4.7 volts in simulation, and the rail fell below the requirement after 0.85 milliseconds. The design built successfully but still failed its purpose.

text.zh: 从理想参数到器件取舍
text.en: From Ideal Values to Component Trade-offs

text.zh: 更复杂的任务会要求智能体合成运算放大器滤波器，控制增益、截止频率和Q值，并在最坏容差角落重新运行交流与瞬态分析。EEBench还使用真实制造商器件，把数据手册中的规格带入SPICE模型。因此，成功不只是解出教科书公式，还要找到存在、可订购、价格合理，并且在多个工作条件下仍满足指标的组合。这种电气性能、成本和供应之间的权衡，更接近硬件工程的实际。
text.en: Harder tasks ask agents to synthesize op-amp filters while keeping gain, cutoff frequency, and Q within limits, then rerun AC and transient analyses at worst-case tolerance corners. EEBench also uses real manufacturer parts and carries datasheet specifications into its SPICE models. Success therefore requires more than solving textbook equations. The agent must find a combination that exists, can be ordered, is reasonably priced, and continues to meet its limits across operating conditions. That balance among electrical performance, cost, and supply is closer to practical hardware engineering.

text.zh: 成绩显示进展，也暴露边界
text.en: Results Show Progress and Clear Boundaries

text.zh: 来源给出的9月1日榜单中，Claude Opus 5在13项任务上的得分为61.6%，Grok 4.6为57.1%，Claude Fable 5.1为56.4%。这些分数说明模型已经能在一组不断扩展的电路问题上完成有用工作，但不能直接等同于“会设计完整电路板”。EEBench V1目前主要评估仿真中的模拟和数字设计，还没有覆盖完整布局、制造和实物调试。Grok 4.6的模型卡引用了EEBench，表明这类工程评测开始进入模型能力报告，但不同模型的运行设置和结果仍需要谨慎比较。
text.en: In the September 1 leaderboard reported by the source, Claude Opus 5 scored 61.6% across 13 tasks, followed by Grok 4.6 at 57.1% and Claude Fable 5.1 at 56.4%. These results show that models can already complete useful work on a growing set of circuit problems, but they do not mean that a model can design a complete production board. EEBench V1 mainly evaluates analog and digital design in simulation; full layout, manufacturing, and physical bring-up are not yet covered. Grok 4.6’s model card cites EEBench, suggesting that engineering evaluations are becoming part of model reporting, although settings and results still require careful comparison.

text.zh: 对工程团队而言，仿真驱动的智能体适合承担方案探索、约束检查和失败定位等工作，尤其是在每个要求都能被明确测量时。它不应替代资深工程师对安全、可靠性、EMI、热、制造可行性和实物样机的判断。EEBench最有价值的方向，可能是把失败转化为可学习的反馈：哪个电压越界、哪个容差角落失效，以及是否为了通过测试付出了不必要的成本。下一步真正值得观察的是，模型能否从声明式电路和仿真结果走向布局、制造、测量与迭代闭环。
text.en: For engineering teams, simulation-driven agents appear suited to design exploration, constraint checking, and failure diagnosis, especially when each requirement can be measured explicitly. They should not replace experienced review of safety, reliability, EMI, thermal behavior, manufacturability, or physical prototypes. EEBench’s most valuable direction may be turning failures into learnable feedback: which voltage missed its limit, which tolerance corner failed, and whether the design paid unnecessary cost to pass. The next meaningful test is whether models can move from declarative circuits and simulation results into a loop that includes layout, manufacturing, measurement, and iteration.

text.zh: 结论：能设计部分电路，但还不能盲目交付
text.en: Conclusion: Capable on Some Circuits, Not Ready for Blind Delivery

text.zh: 谨慎的答案是：部分模型已经能够设计一批电路，但“设计电路”与“交付可靠硬件”之间仍有明显距离。EEBench把这个距离变成了可重复的测量，也提醒我们，构建成功并不代表功能成功。随着任务覆盖更多真实器件、工作角落和后续硬件流程，AI PCB设计的能力边界会比单次演示更清楚。现阶段，最合理的定位是让模型参与可验证的工程循环，并把最终责任保留在人类审查和实物验证环节。
text.en: The careful answer is that some models can already design a useful class of circuits, but there remains a clear gap between designing a circuit and delivering reliable hardware. EEBench makes that gap measurable and shows why a successful build is not the same as functional success. As evaluations add more real components, operating corners, and downstream hardware steps, the boundary of AI PCB design will become clearer than any single demonstration can show. For now, the sensible role is to use models inside a verifiable engineering loop while retaining final responsibility for human review and physical validation.
